result_preview.title: Material Receipt Inbound API
result_preview.shortDescription: REST API for creating and managing goods receipt transactions against purchase orders.
result_preview.description: Enables integration systems and warehouse management applications to post goods receipts in real-time against procured materials. Supports batch material receipt posting, quality inspection workflows, and stock reservation updates. Critical for supply chain visibility and inventory accuracy in manufacturing operations.

result_preview.title: Purchase Order Network API
result_preview.shortDescription: REST API for creating, updating, and monitoring purchase orders across supplier networks.
result_preview.description: Enables programmatic access to purchase order lifecycle management including creation, approval workflows, and real-time status tracking. Supports bulk operations and integration with enterprise procurement systems to streamline order-to-cash processes and improve supplier collaboration.

result_preview.title: Vendor Invoice Reconciliation Agent
result_preview.shortDescription: Autonomously matches vendor invoices to POs and contracts, flags discrepancies for approval.
result_preview.description: This agent automatically reconciles incoming vendor invoices against purchase orders and master contracts using three-way matching logic. It validates line-item quantities, pricing, and terms; flags exceptions such as overbilling, duplicate invoices, or policy violations; and routes approved invoices for payment processing. This reduces manual touchpoints, accelerates cash flow, and minimizes payment disputes.
